2022.title: Birth of ChroniCaree
2022.description: Our journey began with a simple idea: to improve the quality of life for people with chronic diseases. We started developing our first prototypes and conducting research with patients and doctors.

2023.title: First implementations
2023.description: We launched our pilot program in 5 healthcare centers. The results exceeded our expectations: 75% improvement in medication adherence and significant reduction in emergency room visits.

2024.title: Growth and recognition
2024.description: We expanded to 50+ healthcare institutions across the country. We received the 'Digital Health Innovation' award and formed strategic partnerships with leading technology companies.

2025.title: International expansion
2025.description: Today we are present in multiple countries, serving over 100,000 patients and 5,000 healthcare professionals. Our AI continues to evolve, offering increasingly personalized and effective care.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: We resolve the most common doubts about ChroniCaree

start.question: How can I start using ChroniCaree?
start.answer: It's very simple. You just need to download our app from your affiliated hospital, register with the information provided by your doctor, and follow the 5-minute interactive tutorial. That's it! You'll start receiving reminders and can record your health data immediately.

security.question: Is my health data secure?
security.answer: Absolutely. We comply with the strictest medical security standards (HIPAA), use end-to-end encryption, and your data is never shared without your explicit authorization. Your privacy is our number one priority.

forget.question: What happens if I forget to record my data?
forget.answer: Don't worry. The app will send friendly reminders, and you can record data from previous days. Additionally, our system learns your patterns and adjusts reminders to be more convenient for you.

replace.question: Does ChroniCaree replace doctor visits?
replace.answer: No, ChroniCaree complements and improves your medical care. It helps you arrive better prepared for your appointments, keeps your doctor informed between visits, and can help detect changes that require early attention.

offline.question: Does it work without internet?
offline.answer: Yes, you can record your data offline and it will sync automatically when you have connection. Basic functions like reminders and recording work perfectly without internet.

integration.question: How does ChroniCaree integrate with our hospital system?
integration.answer: We offer complete integration with major electronic medical record systems (EMR/EHR). Our technical team handles the entire implementation process, including data migration, staff training and ongoing support.

implementation.question: How long does implementation take?
implementation.answer: Typical implementation takes 2-4 weeks, including setup, system integration, staff training and pilot testing. We provide 24/7 support throughout the entire process.

diseases.question: What types of chronic diseases does the platform handle?
diseases.answer: ChroniCaree is effective for diabetes, hypertension, heart disease, COPD, arthritis, and many other chronic conditions. Our protocols are customizable according to the specific needs of each specialty.

pricing.question: How does the pricing model work?
pricing.answer: We offer scalable plans based on the number of active patients. Includes all functionalities, updates, technical support and training. No hidden costs or surprises.

results.question: What results can we expect?
results.answer: Our clients report: 45% reduction in preventable hospitalizations, 80% improvement in treatment adherence, 60% reduction in emergency calls, and 95% satisfaction from both patients and physicians.
